changelog: First release: portable Markdown profile for cross-AI-tool transfer (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Codex CLI, OpenClaw, Continue, Aider, ChatGPT/Claude web). Like vCard for AI assistants — extract once, paste anywhere. Zero infrastructure, privacy-controlled, standardized 5-category format. Includes memory-file map for 10+ tools and import-prompt templates.
summary: Extract a standardized cross-tool user profile from any AI agent's long-term memory (USER.md, MEMORY.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, etc.) so you can...
